name: APL Apollo Tubes Ltd.
business_summary: India's largest branded structural steel tubes maker: MS black pipes, galvanised and pre-galvanised tubes and hollow sections from ~10 plants, sold through a large distributor network into housing, urban infrastructure, solar structures and irrigation. Pure conversion model: HRC is ~90% of costs and prices are reset to hold EBITDA per tonne (~Rs6,000/t). Q2 FY27 volume a record 9.63 lakh t (+13% YoY), sales Rs7,002 cr, EBITDA Rs578 cr (8%), PAT Rs382 cr. TTM sales Rs24,860 cr, EBITDA margin 7.9%, market cap Rs60,639 cr (46x P/E), nearly debt-free.

exposures.mechanism: HRC/GP coil is ~90% of costs but product prices are reset to hold EBITDA/tonne (~Rs6,000/t in Q2 FY27 on ~Rs72,700/t realisation; sales Rs7,002 cr / 9.63 lakh t). +7% steel = ~Rs5,000/t; ~3 weeks of inventory (~0.22 Mt) => one-off gain ~Rs110 cr = ~5.7% of TTM EBITDA Rs1,972 cr; persistence 0.25, EV/MCap ~1.0 => +1.4. Offset: price hikes slow volumes (price hikes 2026-09-23 and 2026-10-01). Empirical steel factors not significant.

evidence.note: TradingView: record Q2 volume and INR 6,000/ton EBITDA despite supply and UAE disruptions
NDTV Profit: APL Apollo raises product prices; further hike Oct 1

exposures.mechanism: Safeguard/anti-dumping on flat steel lifts HRC price (+10pp duty ~ +5% HRC): inventory gain short-term (+) but raises cost of competing imports of tubes less than input, and strengthens integrated mills (Tata/JSW/JSPL) that sell branded tubes. Sign genuinely ambiguous; central slightly negative.

Structural tubes and black pipes go into residential, commercial and urban infrastructure. +10% housing sales => ~+3% volumes, EBITDA op. leverage ~1.3x => +4% EBITDA x EV/MCap 1.0 x persistence 0.5 => +2.0. Volume growth Q2 FY27 was +13% YoY (record 9.63 lakh t) vs FY27 target in question per Livemint 2026-10-06.
Railway/station, airport, solar-structure and irrigation projects use structural hollow sections. +10% capex growth => ~+4% volumes, +5% EBITDA, x1.0 x0.5 => ~+2.5.
Warehousing, industrial sheds, data-centre and solar mounting structures; +10% private capex => ~+2.5% volumes => +1.5 equity after persistence.
Irrigation pipes, greenhouses and agri structures plus tier-3 housing; +5pp rural growth => ~+1.5% volumes => ~+1.0.

Repo hiked to 5.50% on 2026-10-07. Interest only Rs156 cr TTM vs EBITDA Rs1,972 cr so direct cost small (25bp x ~Rs 2,500 cr debt = Rs6 cr). Larger effect: P/E 46x discount-rate duty and weaker building/channel credit.

evidence.note: Google News: Reuters 2026-10-07 'India first hike in nearly 4 years'; SCC Online 'repo to 5.50%, calibrated tightening'

exposures.mechanism: Zinc for galvanising ~3% of costs; +10% zinc => +0.3% cost => ~-4% EBITDA if unrecovered, but passed through in 1-2 months => -0.3 after persistence 0.25.
Domestic HRC priced at import parity, so a weaker rupee lifts steel prices (inventory gain, as for F_STEEL_INDIA); small direct FX exposure (UAE/Nepal operations, some exports). +3% USD/INR => ~+0.4.
Q2 FY27 call headline cites 'supply and UAE disruptions' (TradingView 2026-10-26); escalation hits Gulf exports/sourcing and freight. Details not verified; low confidence.
Beta ~1.0 and FIIs have been trimming (37.5% to 34.2% since Mar 2026) while DIIs add; empirical +0.45 (t=1.0) has opposite sign - treated as noise, central shaded small negative.
